policy: A quality-gate stage whose subject module does not exist yet is a FAILED GATE, not a pass. The export/finance, Angular and Playwright stages are the three places where that rule has teeth: they name modules the migration has not built yet, so until they exist the pipeline is red on purpose.
mechanism: To make such a stage pass, add an entry naming the stage, then run run-gates.ps1 with -AllowPendingStages. Without a matching, unexpired entry the flag does nothing: -AllowPendingStages alone cannot turn a missing module green.
rules: One entry names exactly one stage from ops/quality/gate-stages.json.
The reason must say which phase will create the module.
The entry is removed in the same commit that creates the module.
